Session date: 9:17 am on 26 June, 2023
[D14:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! How's it going? We haven't talked in a while. I've been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies. A chance to hang out with people who think like me and find peace and understanding. Sounds awesome!
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D14:2] Jolene: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!
[D14:3] Deborah: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed?
[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D14:4] Jolene: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday.
[...]
[D14:7] Deborah: Pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright. 
[D14:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field
[D14:8] Jolene:  I'm so thankful it's here. Plus, it's nice to have a calm creature around.
[...]

Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
[D7:3] Jolene: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo.
[D7:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose
[D7:4] Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
[D7:5] Jolene: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo.
[...]
[D7:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[...]
[D4:12] Deborah: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
[D4:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose
[D4:13] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
[D4:14] Deborah: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
[D4:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair
[D4:15] Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
[...]
[D4:17] Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
[D4:18] Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
[D4:19] Jolene: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
